communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide all contracts, Master Services Agreements, order forms, pilot program agreements, Memorandums of Understanding, task orders, amendments, renewals, and addendums between the City of Pontiac and Flock Safety / Flock Group Inc., concerning automated license plate reader hardware, software, or services used by or for the City, together with associated invoices and data-retention policies.

Please include all attachments and exhibits and any terms and conditions incorporated into these agreements that are maintained by the City.

Please provide records electronically. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption. If fulfilling any portion would result in substantial cost or delay, please provide the readily available records first and advise me before incurring substantial charges.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford

communications.subject: Michigan Freedom of Information Act Request: Flock Audit Pontiac MI
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I request the following records concerning the City of Pontiac’s use of Flock Safety:

1. Organization Audit Log
The complete Flock Organization Audit Log for the period 2026-08-01 through 2026-10-31

2. Network Audit Log
The complete Flock Network Audit Log for the period 2026-08-01 through 2026-10-31

These records may be available through the Flock administrative dashboard under Insights. Flock documentation states that customers may download these audit logs as spreadsheets in 31-day increments and recommends contacting Flock customer support for assistance with periods longer than six months.

Please provide the records in their original electronic format (CSV, Excel, or other native spreadsheet export), preserving all fields/columns contained in the original export, rather than converting the records to PDF.

If any field or portion of a record is withheld or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption relied upon for that withholding.

If retrieving the entire requested period would result in substantial cost or delay, please provide the readily available portions first and advise me before incurring substantial charges.

3. Shared Networks Export
This is a request under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act for the current Flock Safety Network Sharing or Shared Networks export for the City of Pontiac, preferably the original SharedNetworks.csv or equivalent native electronic export. This is the Flock record showing organizations or networks sharing data with Pontiac and organizations or networks with which Pontiac shares data. Please provide the original electronic file generated by Flock rather than converting it to PDF or reformatting it. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption.

4. Administrative Event Log
This is a request under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act for the City of Pontiac’s Flock Safety Event Log. Please provide the available Event Log in its original electronic CSV or other native export format, including all fields contained in the export, for dates 2026-01-01 to the 2026-10-31 (2026 year-to-date). The requested record is the Flock administrative event log recording actions such as changes to hotlists, network sharing, users or roles, cameras, or other system administration. Please provide the original electronic file generated by Flock rather than converting it to PDF or reformatting it. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford
